summary: The first difference follows the punished amphibious drown path: C calls unplacebc() and placebc(), while JS records both calls as unported gaps. placebc() invokes flooreffects() for the chain and, when it is not carried, the ball; those effects call water_damage(). The C rn2(20) at trap.c:4771 is the first of these effects after JS has skipped the relocation calls.

source.branch: drown() reaches its Amphibious || Breathless || Swimming branch with Punished true after water_damage_chain; before setting uinwater, C calls unplacebc() and placebc().
callers: trap.c:dotrap calls drown() for the water-entry trap effect; js/trap_effects.js:dotrap awaits drown(state).
dependencies: ball.c:unplacebc removes the current floor placement while retaining the hero's ball and chain pointers.
ball.c:placebc calls placebc_core, which applies flooreffects to the chain and to a non-carried ball.
do.c:flooreffects calls trap.c:water_damage for objects on a pool square.
